summary: Spec 7 ARTIGIANI enhancements (iter27) — backend + frontend PASSED. NEW backend features fully verified with pytest 9/9 in ~3s (test_artigiani_iter27_enhancements.py): (1) GET /api/artigiani/config now exposes 'parametri' (all 6 mestieri: idraulico cascade + elettricista/caldaista/climatizzazione select with marca_modello text + giardiniere number+text + tuttofare free-text), 'fasce_orarie' [mattina, pomeriggio, sera], and 'chiamata_default' with the 5 keys chiamata_base/per_km/km_inclusi/urgenza_pct/minimo. (2) PUT /api/artigiani/listino accepts the new 5 chiamata_* fields (base 40, per_km 1.5, km_inclusi 5, urgenza_pct 20, minimo 40) plus tariffa_oraria/raggio_km/binario/paniere/urgenze; GET returns them verbatim. (3) Variable call-out fee by real haversine distance: /estimate NEAR (Treviso 0km) = €40.00 (base clamped to minimum), FAR (+0.20 lng ≈ 15.5km) = €40 + 1.5*(15.5-5) = €55.75; with urgente=true FAR = €55.75 × 1.20 = €66.90; provider /incoming my_price uses raw (unrounded) distance so equals €55.81 for the same far point — semantically correct even if it differs from estimate() by ±0.1 due to rounding (see minor issue). (4) Structured parametri stored: POST /richieste with parametri={ambiente:{categoria:'bagno',elemento:'doccia'}}, fascia_oraria='mattina', data_ora=YYYY-MM-DD future — GET richiesta shows config.parametri deep-equal, config.fascia_oraria='mattina', and top-level data_ora==future. (5) Preventivo scomputo toggle: scomputo_chiamata=true → preventivo.scomputo == r.chiamata_fee (55.81 far example), da_pagare = totale-scomputo; scomputo_chiamata=false → preventivo.scomputo == 0.0 and da_pagare == totale. Response also echoes scomputo_chiamata bool. (6) PANIERE regression: full paniere flow (idraulico/miscelatore €70) still works unchanged — create→invite→propose(€70)→confirm sets pagamento.stato='intervento_pagato' and chiamata_fee=0. minor.issue: Rounding drift between estimate() (uses distance rounded to 1 decimal from compatible_providers) and incoming() (uses raw haversine). For a ~15.54km point, estimate returns €55.75 while incoming returns €55.81 (diff €0.06). Not a bug per se (both formulas are correct, monotonic with distance), but the two client-facing surfaces disagree by cents. Consider consolidating: either round distance once (dist_km) and use it in both, OR remove the rounding in compatible_providers/estimate. Fix suggestion: in routers/artigiani.py::incoming() replace `dist = haversine(...)` with `dist = round(haversine(...), 1)` to match estimate() output exactly.

critical_code_review_comments: artigiani_config.py::PARAMETRI is well-structured — cascade shape {type:'cascade', options:[{id,label,sub:[{id,label}]}]} lets the FE render 2-level chip pickers with a single component (verified in configura.tsx render*() branches). Extending mestieri only needs a config change, not code.

artigiani_config.py::DEFAULT_CHIAMATA is used as a safety fallback in compute_chiamata_fee() when the provider hasn't set any chiamata_* fields. This preserves backward compat with older listini that only have flat 'chiamata_fee'.

artigiani.py::compute_chiamata_fee() correctly clamps to `minimo` AFTER the urgenza multiplier — meaning a very short trip with urgenza still returns at least the minimo. Confirmed: fee = round(max(base + per_km*extra_km) * (1+urg/100), minimo, 2).

artigiani.py::compose_preventivo() uses `r.get('chiamata_fee', 0)` for the scomputo cap, so scomputo == chiamata_fee that was locked at confirm() time (immutable). This is correct — later /extra additions don't rewrite it.

configura.tsx paramsValid() (line ~62) — cascade requires BOTH categoria AND elemento to be set before enabling Avanti; select fields require an id (with needs_text also require text.trim()); number fields require Number(v)>0; text fields require non-empty trim. Robust guard.

listino.tsx DEFAULT_LISTINO (line 12) includes all 5 new chiamata_* fields with sensible defaults matching backend DEFAULT_CHIAMATA — so a brand-new provider immediately has functional call-out pricing.

[id].tsx line 118 shows label 'Scomputa il diritto di chiamata (€X.XX)' with the LIVE chiamata_fee value; toggle wires to api.artPreventivo scomputo_chiamata field. Total-line preview (line 121) reflects the deduction in real time.
